name: manual_b641aa
claim: A new regression test passing is not TDD GREEN by itself -- run the whole neighboring test file, not just the new test, since a fix aimed at one failure mode can silently break an established, adjacent positive invariant it never re-checked

decisions.notes: 2026-09-13, oramasys/orama-system PR #357: after adding a concurrency-guard fix, the new negative regression test (rejecting a stale-write race) passed, but the pre-existing, established happy-path test (test_append_pr_body_consumes_grant) failed on the exact same head -- a genuinely correct concurrency design implemented with the wrong equality check. The failure was only caught because the full test file (pytest tests/test_append_pr_body_grant_flow.py -v, not just the single new test) was run and inspected. A safety guard that only ever passes failure scenarios and rejects all successful operations is not a valid improvement, however sound its underlying design. Full write-up: .agent/memory/working/ORAMA_PR357_PR_BODY_INTEGRITY_FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_RECOVERY_2026-09-13.md.
